plugins.name: Miftah — مفتاح (Alpha)
plugins.description: Safe hot replacement with state-lock handover and rollback; one final restart required when upgrading from alpha.7 or older. Authenticated native /v1/models returns the global catalog; execution stays per-key restricted. Searchable models, fallback, theme, routes and budgets; native keys preserved. No Docker socket or custom image. STAGING ONLY: Linux amd64, glibc >= 2.34; NOT Alpine/musl or ARM64. Tested with CPA v7.2.146. Read INSTALL.md.
plugins.author: Abdulaziz
